trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Two denial constructions, both load-bearing disambiguation rather than manufactured emphasis. 'These values are not the physical mass ratios m_mu/m_e approx 206.8 and m_tau/m_e approx 3477' guards the reader against reading net-coefficient ratios of 1.245 and 1.545 as mass predictions — exactly the numerology misreading the corpus's anti-fit discipline exists to prevent, and it names the true values so the gap is visible. 'The even-n entries do not represent torus knots' is likewise precise: T(2,n) for even n is a 2-component torus LINK, not a knot.
